userStories.title: Fix 3 ObservationLog .log() → .log_observation() method name bugs in engine.py
userStories.description: engine.py calls self._observation_log.log() at 3 sites (consensus_penalty ~line 2722, regime_default ~line 3819, execution_fasttrack ~line 4271). The method does not exist — it is named log_observation(). These silently raise AttributeError on every trigger, caught by the outer try/except and logged at DEBUG only. Fix: rename all 3 .log() calls to .log_observation(). Each call signature already passes category, pair, data kwargs which log_observation() accepts.

userStories.title: Wire PairModelSelector — active model query in _scan_pair(), record_prediction() after trade close
userStories.description: PairModelSelector is initialized (self._pair_model_selector) but never called. Wire 3 sites: (A) In _scan_pair(), after the model ensemble is selected but before scanning, call get_active_model(pair) and log at DEBUG which model variant is active. (B) In record_trade_outcome_phase18(), call record_prediction(pair, model_type, predicted_direction, actual_direction) using model arg and trade_won to derive actual_direction. (C) In scan() periodically (every 50 cycles via _scan_cycle_count % 50 == 0), call check_switch(pair) for each pair and execute_switch(pair, new_model) if a switch is recommended.

userStories.title: Wire ChainMemory lifecycle — sync_from_prd() at scan start, record_chain_complete() at scan end
userStories.description: ChainMemory (self._chain_memory) is initialized but sync_from_prd(), record_chain_complete(), and record_phase_complete() are never called. Wire 2 sites: (A) In scan() at the top before pairs loop, call sync_from_prd() once per session (gated by a _chain_memory_synced flag, set on first call). (B) In scan() after ScanResult is assembled (before return), call record_chain_complete(result_dict) where result_dict contains: phase=_scan_cycle_count, pairs_scanned=len(analyses), signals=sum(a.should_trade for a in analyses). Wrap both in try/except (non-blocking).
